title: ExchangeEnvelope
description: Transport envelope of the federated exchange. Wraps a set of digital object cards transferred between nodes. Carries protocol metadata: version, sender/receiver node identifiers, exchange type, timestamp.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of envelope generation

sender_node_guid.description: UUID of the sending node. Must match the federation_node_guid of the registered sender

receiver_node_guid.description: UUID of the receiving node. Optional: omitted for broadcast to group subscribers

exchange_type.description: publish — new object card(s); dedup_request — request for duplicate check; dedup_response — result of duplicate check; enrich_response — cards enriched with attributes and confirmed/rejected linkages

objects.description: Digital object cards. For publish — new cards; for dedup_response — cards with candidate linkages; for enrich_response — enriched cards returned to the source node

persons.description: Persons (experts) referenced by the cards of this envelope — exchange context, not a global registry. Each person is owned by a node (its source_node_guid); full identity is the pair (federation_node_guid, person_guid)

relations.description: Record linkage relations carried by the envelope (e.g. same_as between AK1 and BK1 with linkage status)
